name: amoCRM
description: Let your AI work in amoCRM: find and update deals across pipelines, look up contacts and companies, read tasks, notes and the event log, and log new tasks and notes. For accounts on amocrm.ru, with a long-lived token from an integration in your account.
instructions:
## amoCRM
This connector works with one amoCRM account on `amocrm.ru` through the **API v4** (`https://<subdomain>.amocrm.ru/api/v4`): deals (leads) with pipelines and stages, contacts, companies, custom fields, tasks, notes, users and the account's event log. It can create and update deals, create contacts and tasks, and add notes. It authenticates with a **long-lived token** (долгосрочный токен) of an integration in your own account.

**Which connector**: amoCRM and Kommo are the same product. Accounts at `<subdomain>.amocrm.ru` use this connector; the old international addresses `<subdomain>.amocrm.com` forward there, so enter the same subdomain. Accounts at `<subdomain>.kommo.com` use the **Kommo** connector.

**Setup (account administrator, about 5 minutes)**
1. In amoCRM open **амоМаркет** (amoMarket) in the left menu, click **⋯** in the top right (next to **+ WEB HOOKS**) and choose **Создать интеграцию** (Create integration), then **Внешняя интеграция** (external integration).
2. Enter a **Ссылка для перенаправления** (redirect URL): the form requires one, but the long-lived token never uses it, so any https address of yours will do. Tick the accesses under **Предоставить доступ**, give the integration a name and description, and click **Сохранить** (Save).
3. Open the integration's **Ключи и доступы** (Keys and scopes) tab and click **Сгенерировать токен** (Generate token). Pick an expiry date (1 day to 5 years) and copy the token right away: amoCRM shows it only once.
4. Paste it into `AMOCRM_ACCESS_TOKEN`, and your account's subdomain into `AMOCRM_SUBDOMAIN`: for `https://acme.amocrm.ru` enter `acme`.
5. The token acts as the administrator who created it. Revoke it on the integration's **Выданные доступы** tab with **Отозвать доступ**; when it expires, generate a new one.

**Read-only setup**: amoCRM tokens cannot be limited to reading, so switch off `amocrm_create_lead`, `amocrm_update_lead`, `amocrm_create_contact`, `amocrm_create_task` and `amocrm_add_note`. Nothing in this connector deletes data.

**Ids and values**: every id is an integer, except event ids, which are strings. Deals are called leads in the API. Deal stages are `status_id` values inside a `pipeline_id` from `amocrm_list_pipelines`; 142 is Closed-won (Успешно реализовано) and 143 Closed-lost (Закрыто и не реализовано) in every pipeline. Loss reasons (the `loss_reason_id` of a lost deal) come from `amocrm_list_loss_reasons`. Responsible users come from `amocrm_list_users`. Phone, email and all other extra data live in `custom_fields_values`: `[{"field_id": 123, "values": [{"value": "..."}]}]`, select options by `enum_id`, contact phone and email by `field_code` PHONE or EMAIL with `enum_code` such as WORK; `amocrm_list_custom_fields` lists ids and options. Dates are Unix timestamps in seconds. Linked entities are in `_embedded`; add `with=contacts` (leads) or `with=leads` (contacts) to get them.

**Where to start**: `amocrm_get_account` (account, currency, task types), then `amocrm_list_leads` / `amocrm_get_lead`, `amocrm_list_contacts` / `amocrm_get_contact`, `amocrm_list_companies` and `amocrm_list_tasks`.

**Notes and events**: `amocrm_list_notes` reads one record's timeline; `amocrm_list_notes_by_type` reads the notes of all leads, contacts or companies at once, filtered by note type, record ids or update time (e.g. every call logged this week). `amocrm_list_events` reads the account's event log: stage changes (`lead_status_changed`), new records, field and responsible-user changes, calls, chat messages, completed tasks. Its entity filter uses singular names (`lead`, `contact`, `company`, `customer`, `task`), unlike the other tools.

**Pagination**: list tools take `page` (from 1) and `limit` (up to 250; 100 for `amocrm_list_events`). The response's `_links.next` shows that more exists; an empty answer (HTTP 204, no body) means there are no results or no more pages.

**Rate limits**: at most 7 requests per second per integration and 50 per account. Over it amoCRM answers 429; repeated violations block the account's API access with 403 for every call. Avoid paging through all deals or events when a filter or search does the job.

**Errors**: 401 means the token is wrong, expired or revoked, or no account has this subdomain on amocrm.ru (a Kommo account belongs in the Kommo connector). 402 means the subscription has ended: writes stop at once, reads 30 days later. 403 can mean the token's user lacks rights or API access was blocked after too many requests. 404 is a wrong id. 400 lists the invalid fields under `validation-errors`, for example a stage that does not belong to the pipeline or a custom field value of the wrong type.

**Out of scope here**: deleting entities, customers (покупатели), unsorted (incoming) leads, chats and messages, lists (catalogs), webhooks and Salesbot.

AMOCRM_SUBDOMAIN.label: amoCRM subdomain
AMOCRM_SUBDOMAIN.help: The first part of your account address: acme for https://acme.amocrm.ru. A pasted full address is shortened to it.

AMOCRM_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Long-lived token
AMOCRM_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: amoCRM → амоМаркет → your integration → Ключи и доступы → Сгенерировать токен. It is shown only once.
AMOCRM_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without spaces or the word Bearer.

verifyHints.401: amoCRM refused the token, or no account has this subdomain on amocrm.ru. Check the subdomain (acme for https://acme.amocrm.ru; a kommo.com account needs the Kommo connector) and generate a new long-lived token under амоМаркет → your integration → Ключи и доступы.
verifyHints.402: amoCRM reports that the account's subscription has ended. Renew it in amoCRM, then try again.
verifyHints.403: amoCRM denied access: the token's user lacks rights, or API access was blocked after too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
verifyHints.404: amoCRM did not find this address. Use the first part of your account address, e.g. acme for https://acme.amocrm.ru.
verifyHints.rate_limited: amoCRM allows 7 requests per second per integration. Wait a moment and try again.

prerequisites: An amoCRM account on amocrm.ru (a trial works) and an account administrator, who creates an integration in амоМаркет and generates its long-lived token (about 5 minutes).

tools.name: amocrm_get_account
tools.description: Get the amoCRM account: id, name, subdomain, current user id, country, currency, language, and with the default extras its task types (ids for tasks) and date and time settings.

with.description: Comma-separated extras: task_types, users_groups, datetime_settings, version, entity_names (default task_types,datetime_settings).

tools.name: amocrm_list_leads
tools.description: List or search deals (leads in the API): id, name, price, pipeline and stage (status_id), responsible user, dates, tags, custom fields and, with with=contacts, linked contacts. Free-text query, filters by pipeline, stage, responsible user and dates, sorting. Up to 250 per page; an empty answer means no more pages.

query.description: Search text, matched against the lead's filled fields (name, custom fields, linked contact data).

status_pipeline_id.description: With status_id: the pipeline of that stage. Filters one stage of one pipeline.

status_id.description: With status_pipeline_id: only leads in this stage.

responsible_user_ids.description: Only entries whose responsible user is one of these user ids.

created_from.description: Created at or after this Unix time (seconds).

created_to.description: Created at or before this Unix time (seconds).

updated_from.description: Updated at or after this Unix time (seconds).

updated_to.description: Updated at or before this Unix time (seconds).

closed_from.description: Closed at or after this Unix time (seconds).

closed_to.description: Closed at or before this Unix time (seconds).

with.description: Comma-separated extras: contacts, loss_reason, source, catalog_elements.

tools.name: amocrm_get_lead
tools.description: Get one lead by id with its name, price, pipeline, stage, responsible user, dates, tags, custom field values, linked company and, by default, linked contacts.

with.description: Comma-separated extras: contacts, loss_reason, source, catalog_elements (default contacts).

tools.name: amocrm_create_lead
tools.description: Create a lead, optionally in a given pipeline and stage, with price, responsible user, custom fields, tags and links to existing contacts and a company. Returns the new lead id. Show the user what will be created and wait for confirmation; never retry a successful create.

price.description: Sale value in the account currency.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline id from amocrm_list_pipelines (default: main pipeline).

status_id.description: Stage id in that pipeline (default: its first stage).

responsible_user_id.description: Responsible user id from amocrm_list_users (default: the token's user).

custom_fields_values.description: Custom field values: [{"field_id": 123, "values": [{"value": "text or number"}]}]; select fields take [{"enum_id": 456}]; contact phone and email use {"field_code": "PHONE", "values": [{"value": "+1 555 0100", "enum_code": "WORK"}]}. Field ids from amocrm_list_custom_fields.

company_ids.description: Company to link, e.g. [{"id": 456}] (a lead has at most one).

tools.name: amocrm_update_lead
tools.description: Change a lead: name, price, stage or pipeline (moving it through the funnel; Closed-won is status 142, Closed-lost 143), responsible user, loss reason, custom fields or tags. Only the given fields change. Confirm with the user before writing.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline id; send with status_id when moving to another pipeline.

status_id.description: Stage id from amocrm_list_pipelines; 142 closes as won, 143 as lost.

loss_reason_id.description: Loss reason id, when closing as lost.

custom_fields_values.description: Custom field values: [{"field_id": 123, "values": [{"value": "text or number"}]}]; select fields take [{"enum_id": 456}]; contact phone and email use {"field_code": "PHONE", "values": [{"value": "+1 555 0100", "enum_code": "WORK"}]}. Field ids from amocrm_list_custom_fields.

tools.name: amocrm_list_contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts: id, name, first and last name, responsible user, dates, tags, custom fields (phone and email are custom fields) and, with with=leads, linked leads. Up to 250 per page; an empty answer means no more pages.

query.description: Search text, matched against names and custom field values such as phone or email.

responsible_user_ids.description: Only entries whose responsible user is one of these user ids.

updated_from.description: Updated at or after this Unix time (seconds).

updated_to.description: Updated at or before this Unix time (seconds).

tools.name: amocrm_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id with names, responsible user, tags, custom field values (phones, emails, position), linked companies and, by default, linked leads.

tools.name: amocrm_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact with name, responsible user, phone, email and other custom fields, and tags. Returns the new contact id; link it to a lead with amocrm_create_lead or in amoCRM. Confirm with the user before writing; amoCRM does not check for duplicates here, so search first.

name.description: Full name (or set first_name and last_name).

responsible_user_id.description: Responsible user id (default: the token's user).

custom_fields_values.description: Custom field values: [{"field_id": 123, "values": [{"value": "text or number"}]}]; select fields take [{"enum_id": 456}]; contact phone and email use {"field_code": "PHONE", "values": [{"value": "+1 555 0100", "enum_code": "WORK"}]}. Field ids from amocrm_list_custom_fields.

tools.name: amocrm_list_companies
tools.description: List or search companies: id, name, responsible user, dates, tags, custom fields and, with with=leads,contacts, linked leads and contacts. Up to 250 per page; an empty answer means no more pages.

query.description: Search text, matched against the name and custom field values.

responsible_user_ids.description: Only entries whose responsible user is one of these user ids.

updated_from.description: Updated at or after this Unix time (seconds).

tools.name: amocrm_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the lead pipelines with their stages: pipeline id, name, whether main or archived, and per stage (in _embedded.statuses) its id, name, sort order, color and type. Every pipeline also has the system stages 142 (Closed-won) and 143 (Closed-lost).

tools.name: amocrm_list_loss_reasons
tools.description: List the account's loss reasons (причины отказа) for deals: id, name and sort order. A lead closed as lost only carries loss_reason_id; use this list to name the reason, or to pick the id for amocrm_update_lead when closing a deal as lost.

tools.name: amocrm_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields of leads, contacts or companies: id, name, code (PHONE, EMAIL for contacts), type and, for select fields, the enum options with their ids. Use them to read and write custom_fields_values.

tools.name: amocrm_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks: id, text, type, deadline (complete_till), whether completed, result, responsible user and the lead, contact or company it belongs to. Filter by responsible user, state, type or entity. Up to 250 per page; an empty answer means no more pages.

responsible_user_ids.description: Only entries whose responsible user is one of these user ids.

is_completed.description: 1 for completed tasks, 0 for open ones.

task_type_ids.description: Only these task types (1 follow-up, 2 meeting, others from amocrm_get_account).

entity_type.description: Only tasks of this entity type (needed with entity_ids).

tools.name: amocrm_create_task
tools.description: Create a task with a deadline, linked to a lead, contact or company, for a responsible user. Returns the new task id. Confirm with the user before writing.

complete_till.description: Deadline as Unix time in seconds.

entity_type.description: Type of the entity the task belongs to.

task_type_id.description: Task type: 1 follow-up (default), 2 meeting, or a custom type id from amocrm_get_account.

responsible_user_id.description: Responsible user id (default: the token's user).

tools.name: amocrm_list_notes
tools.description: Read the notes (timeline entries) of one lead, contact or company: id, type (common text note, call_in, call_out, sms, service messages, ...), params with the text or call data, author and dates. Up to 250 per page; an empty answer means no more pages.

tools.name: amocrm_list_notes_by_type
tools.description: Read notes across all leads, contacts or companies at once, not just one record: id, entity_id of the record it belongs to, type (common text note, call_in, call_out, sms_in, sms_out, service messages, attachment, ...), params with the text or call data, author and dates. Filter by note type, record ids, note ids and last-update time, e.g. every call logged this week. For one record's timeline use amocrm_list_notes. Up to 250 per page; an empty answer means no more pages.

note_types.description: Only these note types: common, call_in, call_out, service_message, extended_service_message, message_cashier, geolocation, sms_in, sms_out, attachment.

entity_ids.description: Only notes of these records (ids of the chosen entity type).

updated_from.description: Notes changed at or after this Unix time (seconds).

updated_to.description: Notes changed at or before this Unix time (seconds).

tools.name: amocrm_add_note
tools.description: Add a text note to the timeline of a lead, contact or company. Returns the new note id. Confirm the text with the user before writing.

tools.name: amocrm_list_users
tools.description: List the account's users: id, name, email, language and rights, and with with=role,group their role and group. User ids are what responsible_user_id fields hold. Up to 250 per page.

tools.name: amocrm_list_events
tools.description: Read the account's event log: who did what and when. Each event has its id, type (e.g. lead_status_changed, lead_added, custom_field_value_changed, entity_responsible_changed, incoming_call, incoming_chat_message, task_completed), the entity type and id it concerns, the user (created_by), the time (created_at) and value_before / value_after with the old and new stage, responsible user or field value. Filter by event type, entity type and ids, user and time range. Up to 100 per page; an empty answer means no more pages.

types.description: Only these event types, e.g. ["lead_status_changed"], ["lead_added", "contact_added"], ["incoming_call", "outgoing_call"], ["task_completed"], ["entity_responsible_changed"]. custom_field_<FIELD_ID>_value_changed follows one field and cannot be combined with other types.

entity.description: Only events of these entity types, in singular: lead, contact, company, customer, task, or catalog_<LIST_ID>.

entity_ids.description: Only events of these records, up to 10 ids. Needs exactly one type in entity.

created_by.description: Only events caused by these users, up to 10 user ids from amocrm_list_users.

created_from.description: Events at or after this Unix time (seconds).

created_to.description: Events at or before this Unix time (seconds).

ids.description: Only these event ids (event ids are strings).

with.description: Comma-separated extras that add names to the ids: lead_name, contact_name, company_name, customer_name, catalog_element_name, catalog_name.
